title: Tiny, cute telescope
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='tube' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#8a5ce0'/>
      <stop offset='0.5' stop-color='#b48cf0'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#7a4ad0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='tube2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#6fb8f0'/>
      <stop offset='0.5' stop-color='#a8dcff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#4f9ee0'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- tripod legs -->
  <rect x='46' y='62' width='6' height='30' rx='3' fill='#c9a15a'/>
  <rect x='62' y='62' width='6' height='30' rx='3' fill='#e0bd7a' transform='rotate(20 65 65)'/>
  <rect x='31' y='62' width='6' height='30' rx='3' fill='#a8834a' transform='rotate(-20 34 65)'/>
  <!-- tripod hub -->
  <rect x='40' y='58' width='20' height='10' rx='5' fill='#f0c04a'/>
  <!-- main tube -->
  <g transform='rotate(-28 50 48)'>
    <rect x='20' y='40' width='62' height='16' rx='8' fill='url(#tube)'/>
    <!-- eyepiece end -->
    <rect x='10' y='42' width='14' height='12' rx='4' fill='url(#tube2)'/>
    <!-- front lens rim -->
    <rect x='76' y='38' width='10' height='20' rx='5' fill='#ffd863'/>
    <!-- lens sparkle -->
    <circle cx='81' cy='45' r='2.6' fill='#fff6c8'/>
  </g>
  <!-- star peeking in lens -->
  <g transform='rotate(-28 50 48)'>
    <path d='M81 36 l2.2 4.4 4.8 0.7 -3.5 3.4 0.8 4.8 -4.3 -2.3 -4.3 2.3 0.8 -4.8 -3.5 -3.4 4.8 -0.7 z' fill='#ffe9a8' opacity='0.85'/>
  </g>
  <!-- little moon charm on tube -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='36' r='4' fill='#ffb3e6'/>
</svg>
